content.content:
Licence check, applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

(1) Subject. The dependent and each prerequisite it is read against must carry a recorded commitment. A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment — one whose recorded content is a placeholder or a bare skeleton rather than a decision — leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder and the node it sits in.

(2) Licence against mwwxxzyk. No element of the dependent contradicts mwwxxzyk. Fail, naming the element and mwwxxzyk, if any element of the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome mwwxxzyk fixes, or narrows mwwxxzyk by excepting a case it covers.

(3) Licence against mplxzxnm. The same question asked of mplxzxnm: fail, naming the element and mplxzxnm, on any contradiction of mplxzxnm as defined in (2).

(4) Independence. The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular prerequisite clause; which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the endpoints, and invents no rule the prerequisites do not state.
content.rationale: sqwusxql fixes the vocabulary its two carriers quote — a marker for a listed id that names a node and a second one for a listed id that names none — and uses mwwxxzyk for the listed-entry presentation that vocabulary speaks about, mplxzxnm for the muted secondary drawing the marker for a naming-none entry is the hook for. Both uses are one question asked of one dependent text: does the vocabulary it fixes contradict anything a prerequisite it was drawn against already fixes, and does each endpoint record a subject at all. All three nodes are inline commitments in words, so all three sit on the natural layer; the pair covers the natural-to-natural gate cell, evals/natural-to-natural.md, whose licence check is copied as clauses (1)–(3), with the placeholder clause needed for the criterion to be decidable while an endpoint is still a skeleton. Were either prerequisite to land as a requirement sentence on the structured layer, the pair would sit in the structured-to-natural cell, which has no matrix entry and takes the same documented default gate form; the same criterion would still apply, so this is flagged here as a matrix gap rather than re-gated a second way. Because the child is a commitment in words, the check demands no observable: whether the markers are actually emitted on rendered entries, and whether the stylesheet's rules select them, are observables of code-layer artifacts and are gated where those carriers become artifacts, at the panel and stylesheet carriers' own evaluations against this vocabulary. Probing the markup here would re-test those artifacts from a node that decides no behaviour, and would exceed the child's layer. The criterion never defines the dependent, restates it, tracks its wording, or names the markers it fixes; which element is at issue is what the check finds, not what the criterion records.
